observation.command:
cd /workspace && SEC=$(node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))")
cat >> config/runtime/base.vars <<EOF

# Auth client secret (local dev). The mock-auth profile still resolves the
# platform auth config, which requires SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET; the OIDC flow
# itself is not exercised in local-builder.
SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=$SEC
EOF
echo "added SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET"
# restart app
pkill -f 'sva-studio-react:serve' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'run-executor.js' 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
nohup pnpm exec tsx /tmp/launch-app2.mjs > /tmp/launch6.log 2>&1 & sleep 4
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
